prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, when the car in the lane beside me drifted over and clipped the side of my vehicle. I felt a hard jolt and pulled onto the shoulder right away. My left shoulder was wrenched in the impact, and I have had pain and stiffness in it since. I gave the same description to the officer at the scene and have not changed the core of what happened, although I have since remembered a few smaller details, such as the other car's color and the time of day. I am the household member of the policyholder, who lives at the same address, and I was driving with permission. I am providing this account so the claim can be reviewed.
